title: BetaManagedAgentsCompactionLimitReachedError
description: The turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call, not because a request failed. The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn.

examples: This turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call. Nothing failed. This can happen when content sent with every request, such as a large system prompt, leaves too little room for the conversation. Send the session a new message to continue; nothing from the stopped turn is discarded.

retry_status.description: What the client should do next.
